artworks.title: The Return of the Argonauts
artworks.description: The Argonauts' homecoming — the fleece-bearing ship after Colchis, Wandering Rocks, and Corcyra.

artworks.title: Plaque with Medea's Murder of Absyrtus
artworks.description: Limoges plaque — Medea's murder of Apsyrtus that delays Aeetes and opens the Argo's return.

artworks.title: The Golden Fleece
artworks.description: Draper's Jason and Medea with the fleece — the prize the return voyage must carry home to Iolcus.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: The flight from Colchis — Medea's brother, the Wandering Rocks, Arete's wedding at Corcyra: the Argo's homeward half.

popCulture.description: The captain who brought the Fleece home — and brought Medea, whose blood delayed Aeetes' pursuit.
